title: check_admin_addr returns Result<(), String>
description: reader/config.rs check_admin_addr() is a public function that returns Result<(), String>. String as an error type in a public API signature is a code smell for library code: callers cannot match on error variants or inspect error structure. The error is currently only used for a startup abort message, but if a caller ever needs to handle this programmatically (distinguish 'non-loopback' from 'missing token') they cannot. The function should return Result<(), ConfigError> (using the existing Validation variant), or a dedicated AdminConfigError. This is the pattern flagged under 'Box<dyn Error> in library API signatures' in the review protocol — String is even less structured than Box<dyn Error>.
